episodes.title: The Calendar Decision: Should a CFO Elect Semiannual Reporting?
episodes.subtitle: SEC File No. S7-2026-15, a 97 percent comment-file revolt, and the board posture that will not wait
episodes.description: An HBS-style case set on 1 September 2026. After the SEC proposed letting U.S. public companies replace Form 10-Q with a semiannual Form 10-S, and after a historically lopsided comment file closed 97 percent opposed, a mid-cap industrial CFO must recommend whether her board should pre-commit to quarterly reporting, prepare to elect, wait for a first cohort, or set a liquidity trigger.

episodes.title: AI ROI Blind Spot: Protiviti Survey
episodes.subtitle: Why many finance leaders still struggle to measure returns on AI investments
episodes.description: A recent Protiviti survey highlights a critical blind spot: while organisations continue to invest heavily in AI, many CFOs and finance teams still lack clear frameworks to measure and report AI returns.

episodes.title: AI ROI Paradox in Finance
episodes.subtitle: When heavy AI investment meets uncertain returns
episodes.description: Significant investment in AI tools is being made, yet clear measurable returns remain elusive for many organisations.

episodes.subtitle: NVIDIA’s Record Quarter and Off-Balance-Sheet AI Commitments
episodes.description: NVIDIA reported record results while research revealed AI-7 companies carry large contractual commitments in footnotes.
